pfas_definition.provenance: Regulated perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) means a class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.

type.provenance: 108946. On and after July 1, 2023, a person, including, but not limited to, a manufacturer, shall not sell or distribute in commerce in this state any new, not previously owned, juvenile product that contains regulated PFAS chemicals.

who.provenance: a person, including, but not limited to, a manufacturer

products.provenance: any new, not previously owned, juvenile product

intentionally_added.provenance: Regulated PFAS means either of the following: (1) PFAS that a manufacturer has intentionally added to a product
